answer: Bonded vouching makes every fake identity cost a real sponsor. A new agent joins only if an established agent vouches for it by locking a bond; if the newcomer is later caught in a Sybil ring, the sponsor's bond is slashed and its own reputation hits a nadir. Honest agents treat the network as a haven and vouch carefully, so an attacker cannot sprout fakes like juniper seedlings: each one needs a bonded voucher willing to risk real stake, and a whole ring burns every bond behind it.
